item.title: Supervisors greenlight SHIELD to protect immigrants
item.description: Santa Cruz County’s immigrant community got a measure of protection Tuesday after the Board of Supervisors approved an ad hoc subcommittee that will address potential impacts from federal immigration enforcement.
